references.text: Gideon received a command from the Lord to tear down Baal's altar and cut down the Asherah pole, and he did this during the night. Verse 28 describes the discovery of this.
King Hezekiah removed the high places, broke the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles, a similar act against idolatry.
Moses gave orders to tear down all the altars, break the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles of the Canaanites.
The altar for the Lord was to be built from uncut stones, in contrast to the pagan altars that were to be destroyed.
King Josiah tore down Baal's altars and cut down the sun pillars and the Asherah poles, a similar reform action.
